items.briefing:
A phishing campaign is currently targeting Microsoft 365 accounts by impersonating the business communications platform RingCentral. Staff may receive convincing-looking emails or login pages designed to steal their credentials — be cautious of any unexpected RingCentral messages asking you to sign in. Separately, SAP Concur has flagged compliance risks around travel expense management, which may be relevant to staff who submit work-related expenses through that platform.

Australian businesses are also being warned about increasing AI investment without proper oversight or tracking of outcomes — a reminder that technology adoption should come with clear guidelines and accountability.

**Tip:** If you receive an unexpected login prompt from any business tool, go directly to the official website rather than clicking links in emails.

featured.title: Australian firms boost AI spend without tracking returns
featured.quote: Australian firms spending heavily on AI without measuring effectiveness or governance poses significant business risks.
